name: Love Status Is Blocked
original_name: สถานะรักถูกปิดกั้น
overview: Complicated feelings, duty and love, and the kind of story where one “blocked” status can change everything — this one already sounds like it could deliver drama, longing, and a whole lot of tension. Adapted from the web novel "Love Status Is Blocked" (สถานะรักถูกปิดกั้น) by ferrary_ff
